card.name: Words right after warn about risk
card.fires_on: The word "of" after "warn them" or "warns them", and the word "risk" or "risks" after "consider these" or "about the". It fires where a warning is about to name a harm.

modes.label: "of" after warn them
modes.description: The linking word "of" right after a verb of warning, before the harm is named.
modes.example: and warn them<< of>> the risk for overdose and death associated with

modes.label: "risk(s)" after a warning lead-in
modes.description: The word risk or risks after "consider these" or "warn ... about the".
modes.example: Consider these<< risks>> when scheduling patients for spinal procedures.

card.writes: It pushes toward warning and risk words such as risk, warning and lure.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is warning someone and is about to say what the danger is.
